description: This PHP source file defines the ImpactProjectDashboardController class, which manages impact project dashboards within a web application. It includes methods for listing, adding, editing, and deleting impact data, impact items, and associated costs, with access control and form handling.

classes.name: ImpactProjectDashboardController
classes.description: Controller class for managing impact project dashboards, including listing, adding, editing, and deleting impact data, impact items, and costs with access control.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Displays a list of impact data projects for a given project, with access control.

methods.name: listByFootprintAction
methods.description: Lists impact data projects associated with a specific footprint within a project.

methods.name: addImpactDataProject
methods.description: Handles creation of new impact data projects, with form processing and optional footprint association.

methods.name: impactItemProjectAction
methods.description: Displays impact items related to a specific impact data entry.

methods.name: addOrEditImpactItemAction
methods.description: Adds or edits an impact project item, with form handling.

methods.name: impactItemProjectCostsAction
methods.description: Lists costs associated with a specific impact project item.

methods.name: addImpactItemProjectCostsAction
methods.description: Adds a new cost to an impact project item.

methods.name: removeImpactItemProjectCostAction
methods.description: Removes a cost from an impact project item.
